display.purpose: Use for the public spec title only.

headline.purpose: Use for major documentation groups such as Schemas.

body.purpose: Use for operation summaries, schema descriptions, and Markdown prose.

mono.purpose: Use for paths, schema names, and code-like identifiers.

elevationMeta.philosophy: Flat by default. Use borders, tonal surfaces, and spacing for depth. Shadows are reserved for floating Goshtoso overlays such as command search.

rules: Motion should communicate state, not decorate content.
Do not animate documentation content on page load.

public-docs-header.description: Stacked on mobile, two-column at medium screens. Contains product eyebrow, spec title, version, and the search trigger.
public-docs-header.classes: flex flex-col gap-4 border-b border-outline pb-6 md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between

operation-section.description: Repeated operation content surface. Flat border, semantic surface, compact padding.
operation-section.classes: rounded-radius border border-outline bg-surface p-4 dark:border-outline-dark dark:bg-surface-dark

schema-row.description: Simple bordered rows under the Schemas section. No card chrome.

command-search.description: Goshtoso search component with global shortcut. Search result IDs are prefixed with search- so content anchors remain unique.

markdown.description: Safe Markdown output wrapper using Goshtoso color and font tokens.

dos: Use Goshtoso semantic tokens before adding Manja-specific CSS.
Keep operation and schema anchors visible and stable.
Use primary only for badges, focus, selected states, and real actions.
donts: Do not create a marketing hero for public docs.
Do not add try-it console behavior in v1.
Do not use Tailwind Typography prose classes for Markdown.
Do not duplicate DOM IDs between search results and content anchors.
